name: module_bridge
title: An authorized stream reaches a module program
summary: yumed authorizes the OPEN and bridges stream bytes over a private UNIX socket. The module is a trusted program running as the daemon's user.

nodes.title: Client
nodes.note: Opens a configured byte-stream service without a destination, for example through a local forward or the C ABI.

nodes.title: yumed
nodes.note: Checks the authenticated identity's service grant before handing the stream to its module adapter.

nodes.title: Module bridge
nodes.note: Connects to the module listener and writes the version, identity and service header before the stream bytes. It preserves both half-closes.

nodes.title: Module program
nodes.note: Accepts the connection and serves it without linking YUME. It runs as the daemon's user, so it can read that user's credential files.
